The '''Waymancy system''' was located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Location" /> It shared its name with the region known as the [[Waymancy Hollow]], inside which the [[Sisters of the Machinesmith]] studied and improved upon [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] technology for a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] leading up to<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref> [[7811 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="EGTW" /> the organization known as the [[Signatories of Waymancy]] fought the Republic in a conflict known as the [[Waymancy Storm]]. By the conclusion of the war, in which the Republic emerged victorious, the object known as the [[Waymancy bridal seat]] had been reduced to a [[hyperspace sinkhole]].<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The Waymancy [[Star system/Legends|system]] later fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] between [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] and [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Waymancy system was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-8.<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
